## Overview
Franco Alessandro Sanchez Trinidad is an AI & Software Engineer based in Puebla, Mexico. He designs and deploys production AI systems and full-stack architectures. Legal name appears on the home page. Canonical title: AI & Software Engineer.

Website: https://www.fsanchezt.com
Email: contacto@fsanchezt.dev
The mailbox is on .dev; the site, sitemap and Person.url are on www.fsanchezt.com. That split is deliberate until the mailbox moves.

## Core Competencies
- **Artificial Intelligence:** LangGraph dashboard at Towel, RAG assistant at UVP, CFDI OCR at Idea15. LangGraph, LangChain, TensorFlow, Pandas, OpenCV.
- **Full-Stack Architecture:** Plant ERP and dashboard (React, PostgreSQL); LTC job board (Next.js, AWS).
- **Delivery:** Scoping and measurement on those systems; mentoring at UVP.

## Key Projects & Impact
- [AI Business Intelligence Dashboard](https://www.fsanchezt.com/projects/ai-business-intelligence-dashboard/): Towel, Oct 2025-present. Operator-reported ~90% drop in weekly report time. Spanish: [es](https://www.fsanchezt.com/es/proyectos/ai-business-intelligence-dashboard/)
- [Smart CFDI Billing System](https://www.fsanchezt.com/projects/smart-cfdi-billing-system/): Idea15, Aug-Sep 2025. Operator-reported ~80% of capture/stamping automated; ~92% projection accuracy on internal history. Spanish: [es](https://www.fsanchezt.com/es/proyectos/smart-cfdi-billing-system/)
- [RAG Institutional Assistant](https://www.fsanchezt.com/projects/rag-institutional-assistant/): UVP, Feb 2024-Jun 2025. Operator-reported ~65% of L1 queries closed without escalation. Spanish: [es](https://www.fsanchezt.com/es/proyectos/rag-institutional-assistant/)
- [Textile Production ERP](https://www.fsanchezt.com/projects/textile-production-erp/): Towel, Oct 2025-present. Operator-reported ~40% workflow visibility; almost no paper on the floor. No screenshots. Spanish: [es](https://www.fsanchezt.com/es/proyectos/textile-production-erp/)
- [AI-Powered Job Matching Board](https://www.fsanchezt.com/projects/ai-powered-job-matching-board/): LTC, 2024-2025. Operator-reported ~75% drop in initial screening time. Spanish: [es](https://www.fsanchezt.com/es/proyectos/ai-powered-job-matching-board/)

Figures are operator-reported. Methods live on each project page. Not third-party audits.
